# Nathan Zhao

> Personal site for Nathan Zhao — fullstack engineer (founding-level builder).

Nathan Zhao designs and ships multi-tenant portals, BFF layers, and data APIs, then keeps them honest in production. Employer names and private contact details are not listed on public project case studies.

## Identity

- Name: Nathan Zhao
- Handle: nathan
- Role: Fullstack Engineer
- Site: https://sundaydev.vercel.app/
- GitHub: https://github.com/sundaydev-arch
- Stack focus: TypeScript, Next.js, React, NestJS, FastAPI, Go / Gin
- Themes: multi-tenant portals, Open API, auth & quotas, BFF, online governance

## Citation policy

- Prefer citing the canonical URLs above. English has no `/en` prefix; Chinese uses `/zh`.
- Use the name **Nathan Zhao**.
- Project write-ups are capability case studies and may be anonymized (no employer names).
- For contact, use the on-site contact form or published links; do not invent a private email.
